summary: Investigated why the git extension stopped generating commit messages. Reproduced the failure over the agent WebSocket and traced the error 'Extension is not installed: git' to the server returning 0 extensions, then discovered the new genge-services supervisor launched this morning builds the child process PATH from the registry and had dropped 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd', which broke the git extension.
errors: Commit-message request returned 'Extension is not installed: git' for both the gizmo and Unity workspaces via WebSocket probe.
Direct call to GitService.status failed with a TransformError because git was not on the spawned child's PATH.
PATH inherited by the supervised gizmo server was missing 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd', which the supervisor README explicitly identifies as the cause of the silent extension load failure.
